mechanism: Fluoxetine may increase photosensitivity risk and both agents can cause skin irritation; tazarotene is a retinoid with potential teratogenic effects requiring contraception counseling in fluoxetine-treated patients.
action: Monitor for enhanced photosensitivity and dermatologic adverse effects; ensure adequate contraception in women of childbearing age due to tazarotene teratogenicity; counsel on sun protection.
